info.name: Nova Demo - API Tests
info.description: API test collection for the Nova demo app

exec: pm.test('Response success & data present', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('object'); });

pm.test('Created user shape', function () { var data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('username'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('email'); });
pm.test('Response envelope', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Users list shape', function () { var items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Response has backend and connected flag', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('backend'); pm.expect(json.data).to.have.property('connected'); });

pm.test('Task created shape', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); var data = json.data; pm.expect(data).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(data).to.have.property('title'); });
pm.test('Tenant tasks list shape', function () { var json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); });
